readout_other: four-channel ECoG; running RMS (5-55 Hz) after a 0.1 s blinking light
direction_notes: tDUS plus blinking light increased ECoG activity relative to light alone; the tDUS-only cohort showed no change during tDUS but reduced activity after cessation.

target.label: left visual and right somatosensory cortices

device.model: P21x5–1 scan head deployed by a Sonosite MicroMaxx

timing.protocol_description: tDUS delivered during Trial 2 only, a 10 min period paired (US+Light cohort) or not (US-only cohort) with a 0.1 s light flash every 10 s; ultrasound parameters are listed only in Supplementary Table S1.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Fourteen C57BL/6 mice (Jackson Laboratories, Farmington CT) were randomly assigned into two cohorts (n = 7), one to receive periodic blinking light stimulation with tDUS (the ‘US+Light’ cohort), the other to receive periodic blinking light stimulation without tDUS (the ‘Light-only’ cohort).
